headline: Nigeria Settles 18-Year MMA2 Dispute with Bi-Courtney Aviation
summary: The Federal Government of Nigeria resolved an 18-year legal and administrative dispute with Bi-Courtney Aviation Services over the Murtala Muhammed Airport Terminal 2, clearing the operator to launch regional flights.
why: Bi-Courtney operates Nigeria's primary domestic private terminal; resolving long-standing concession disputes helps restore investor confidence in Nigerian infrastructure contracts.

impacts.name: Bi-Courtney Aviation Services Limited
impacts.why: Resolving the dispute clears the way to operate regional air routes and complete adjacent hotel assets.
